name: Arkansas

statute.name: Arkansas Freedom of Information Act
statute.citation: Ark. Code Ann. § 25-19-101 et seq. (access/fees/timing at § 25-19-105)

response.rule_text: Records must be available immediately unless in active use or storage, in which case within three working days, Ark. Code Ann. § 25-19-105(e); personnel/evaluation records within 24 hours.

fees.labor_rule: Copy fees may not include existing agency personnel time for searching, retrieving, reviewing or copying, § 25-19-105(d)(3)(A)(i).
fees.copy_rule: Actual cost of reproduction (medium, supplies, equipment, maintenance) plus actual mailing/transmission cost; itemized breakdown required, § 25-19-105(d)(3).
fees.waiver_rule: Copies may be furnished free or at reduced charge if records requested primarily for noncommercial purposes (Act 1653 of 2001, § 25-19-105(d)).

residency.rule_text: 'Any citizen of the State of Arkansas' may request, Ark. Code Ann. § 25-19-105(a)(1); includes corporations doing business in state; incarcerated felons barred from DOC records.

appeal.body: Circuit court (Pulaski County or plaintiff's county)
appeal.rule_text: No administrative appeal exists; a citizen denied rights may appeal immediately to circuit court, Ark. Code Ann. § 25-19-107(a). No time limit in the FOIA; general five-year statute presumably applies.

notes: Appeal deadline null (FOIA has none). Coverage of governor/legislature/universities/school districts not confirmed from raw RCFP text. Attorney General issues advisory opinions only. Citation to §25-19-101 inferred from 'et seq.' usage; §25-19-105 and -107 seen in text.
